title: FBI到底有没有：通知黄仁勋，防御简报成最大问号
speaker: Ellie Rostom

segments.en: But you know perhaps it is a reflection of sort of the that I've lived in DC for 20 years and this is sort of given that I used to be a former intelligence analyst.
segments.zh: 但这或许反映了我在华盛顿生活20年的经历，毕竟我曾是情报分析师。

segments.en: It's sort of like the oldest trick in the book to you know fall for this sort of honey pot situation.
segments.zh: 这就像是老套的陷阱，让人容易陷入这种美人计。

segments.en: But I think the what's there are two stories really here. One is a supply chain story and the other one is really an intelligent story.
segments.zh: 但我认为这里有两个层面：一是供应链问题，二是情报问题。

segments.en: Apparently their reports that the intelligence community has followed the story since mid 2024 and they've watched the pair.
segments.zh: 据报道，情报界自2024年中期就关注此事，并监视了这两人。

segments.en: So the first question that comes to mind is did they notify Jensen or not in these particular cases usually you the FBI basically gives you what we call the defensive briefing.
segments.zh: 首先想到的是，他们是否通知了Jensen？通常FBI会提供所谓的防御性简报。

segments.en: And so the I see the intelligence community has a is required to sort of let you know if for intelligence is trying to recruit you.
segments.zh: 情报界有义务告知你，是否有情报机构试图招募你。

segments.en: So that's a sort of a big question right now is whether that actually did happen the extent to which they've collaborated and and Jensen has collaborated with the intelligence community.
segments.zh: 目前一个大问题是，这是否真的发生了，以及Jensen与情报界的合作程度。

segments.en: There's also the question of section 702 of the foreign intelligence for intelligence surveillance act, which has yet to be voted on in Congress but is still active until March of 2027.
segments.zh: 还有《外国情报监视法》第702条的问题，国会尚未投票，但该条款仍有效至2027年3月。

segments.en: Most likely the collection on the woman in question it would most likely have fallen under section 702.
segments.zh: 对涉事女子的信息收集很可能属于第702条范畴。

segments.en: So another key question is really figuring out whether there was a warrant that was issued, especially given the length that the intelligence community has followed the story.
segments.zh: 另一个关键问题是，是否签发了搜查令，尤其是情报界已跟踪此事很久。

segments.en: And they've clearly chosen to disclose it now so any advantage of not just continuing to watch the story they probably exhausted any value in that.
segments.zh: 他们显然选择现在披露，因此继续观望的所谓优势，可能已经耗尽价值。
